change: Roster relation-version reads occur only while at least one actual non-self member consumes relationship badges. Dirty membership rebuilds recompute that need. Social subscriptions and applicant relationship consumers retain their existing ownership and behavior.
regressions: Create retains friend events, a joining teammate immediately resolves a friend badge, FRIENDLIST_UPDATE updates that cached teammate, returning to solo or empty stops index reads, self badges stay false, final detach releases events.
